name: Herman
headline: Turn Odido’s usage data into subscriptions that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells mobile subscriptions, fibre, TV and business lines to every visitor in the same way, from Black Friday deals to family plans. A visitor looking for a new SIM only sees the same front page as a family with several lines.

Once a customer is logged in, their data use, plan changes and the move between prepaid and postpaid are the strongest signals for the next upgrade and the next cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns for mobile, fibre and TV are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer whose contract is ending this week gets the same renewal offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from data use, plan changes and contract end dates. The right offer, channel and moment for each person, tested across mobile, fibre and TV.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Upgrade the right customers, when it fits
cases.text: Next best plan or add-on per customer, triggered by how they use their mobile line, home internet or TV. No more blanket upgrade mails to customers already on the right plan.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every line in use, every week
cases.text: Personal nudges for TV content, home internet and mobile plans, by email, push and web, orchestrated so every customer has a reason to use what they already pay for.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
